areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Flood macrodrainage ties directly to sanitation and the component fits; indicators are not SMART but show objectives; protected population is small relative to the city, so impact is low.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: Sports equipment at only two reservoirs with a relevant indicator, but a tiny resource share and no engagement strategy, so impact is limited.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Related specific objective on restoring micro-basins; the indicator on waste diverted from water bodies is viable but unambitious and its impact is limited relative to the area.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: General objective and component directly aligned, viable indicators and about 90% of resources on flood prevention; directly protected population is small, so moderate impact.

areas.name: Water security
areas.reason: Relevant objectives and component, but the sole related indicator is modest and the effectiveness of water-quality gains for broader water security was not demonstrated.

bonus.reason: Proponent declared alignment with the PPA priority on confronting the climate emergency; resources are fully directed to climate adaptation against floods and droughts.
Proponent did not state the programme promotes regional integration; no points.
